title: Consciousness is to the brain as the sound is to a clock's bell

statements.text: Whether or not animals have souls, consciousness comes into existence as a consequence of molecular motion in the brain. If there is a soul, it stands to the body as the bell of a clock to the works, and consciousness is the sound the bell gives out when it is struck.

sources.quote: The soul stands related to the body as the bell of a clock to the works, and consciousness answers to the sound which the bell gives out when it is struck.
